title: Cellar and Winter
author: Felix Sandoval
blurb: Juniper Sterling, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
